svg.text: Contract tests are the only cheap mechanism that catches cross-service breakage at PR time. Integration tests can't (each

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: side mocks the other); E2E can't run fast enough on every PR.
